system.description:
An alternative version of the Body Pathway Derangement. You, instead of mixing up a creature’s brain signals, you temporarily increase their efficiency.

Select one creature, other than yourself that you can see and touch. The targets body experiences no direct changes, but their central nervous system carries signals significantly faster than previously gaining the following benefits;

The creature’s speed is increased by +10.

+1d4 bonus to Dexterity Saving throws.

So long as you can take an Action, you cannot lose the ability to or be prevented from making a Bonus Action or Reaction.

Only 1 Creature can benefit from this jutsu at a time. If you cast this jutsu targeting another creature, the previous creature loses its benefits.

Additionally, if the creature ever falls under the Shocked condition, this jutsu, immediately ends.
